none.title: No Agent yet
none.body: Create the first Agent on a paired Machine

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: Its Machine may not have listed its Agents yet, or the Agent is gone.

name: Name

machine.heading: On Machine
machine.footer: An Agent stays on one Machine and can touch only that machine's files and tools. The Runtime makes its Workdir at ~/.veeloe/agents/<id>/workdir; you can't pick the path (ADR 0002, 0032).
machine.offline: This Machine is offline. Start veeloe on it first.

asking: Asking the Machine which Providers it has

provider.heading: Provider and model
provider.footer: The models come from the Providers set on this Machine. Someone with Manage can change them later, from the next Task on (ADR 0042).
provider.none: This Machine has no Provider yet
provider.nextTask: A change takes effect from the next Task. A Task already going keeps its model to the end, since changing it midway restarts the prompt cache and loses its thinking. If a Provider goes down, every Agent on the Machine that uses it stops with it (ADR 0042).

budget.heading: Today's Budget
budget.footer: Every token the Provider reports counts. The day turns at 04:00 in the Machine's own time. When it runs out, the Turn going finishes as if stopped, and no new work starts until the next day or someone adds Budget. Set a spend limit at the Provider as well (ADR 0043).
budget.label: Today's Budget
budget.default: The Budget starts at 10M tokens a day. You can change it later on the Agent's page (ADR 0043).

tasks.footer: Only the Tasks you started are here (ADR 0060).

approval.heading: Approval
approval.footer: An Approval nobody answers before this time counts as denied (ADR 0003).

allowlist.heading: Commands that run without asking for an Approval
allowlist.footer: The read-only set is ticked for you; untick what you don't want before signing. There is no find, which has -exec and -delete, no sed, which has -i, and neither git nor npm on its own (ADR 0030).

needsOnline: The Machine is offline. The Agent's settings can be changed once it is back online (ADR 0006).
characterLater: You can change the Character later on the Agent's page.

character.detail: How it looks and moves in the Inbox

problem.provider: Provider {{provider}} is no longer on the Machine, so this Agent can't answer. Pick a new Provider below.
problem.model: Provider {{provider}} no longer lists model {{model}}. Pick a new model below.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The Agent stops and disappears from this list. Its Workdir and Task history stay on the Machine, but it will not answer again.
